items.zh: 值得一提的是这个学校以爱国主义教育为特色，办学卓有成效。
items.en: What is worth mentioning is that the school features in patriotic education, with remarkable results.

items.zh: 顾客投诉昨天新买的衣服一洗就缩水了，说什么都要退钱。
items.en: The customer complained that the clothes he bought yesterday shrank after just one wash, and he demanded a full refund no matter what we offered.

items.zh: 尽管在实验过程中多次遭遇失败，但科研团队从未放弃，最终成功研发出新型材料。
items.en: Despite repeated failures in the experiment, the scientific research team never gave up, and eventually managed to develop the new material.

items.zh: 传统手工艺的传承，不仅需要技艺的传授，更需要年轻一代的文化认同与创新实践。
items.en: The inheritance of traditional handcrafts requires not only the passing down of skills, but also cultural identity and innovative practice of the younger generation.

items.zh: 这辆高铁开往北方，在那里旅客可以享受惊人的自然风光，探索该地区深厚的历史文化。
items.en: The high-speed train leaves for the north, where tourists can enjoy the breathtaking landscape and explore the profound historical and cultural heritagein the region.

items.zh: 在人工智能技术迅猛发展的背景下，传统行业若不能及时转型，就可能面临被淘汰的风险。
items.en: In the context of the rapid development of artificial intelligence, if traditional industries fail to transform business models accordingly, they may be faced the risk of being eliminated.

items.zh: 7 因准备不充分，投资项目中意外不断，旧的问题还没来得及妥善处置，新的问题就纷至沓来。
items.en: Due to inadequate preparation, unexpected issues kept emerging in the investment program, so the new problems poured in one after another before the old ones could be properly addressed.
